questions.q: What are the two steps of the Chronos tokenizer?
options: Mean scaling, then uniform quantization into bins

questions.q: 16 bins between −4 and 4. A scaled value of 0.9 falls in which bin index? (floor((v + 4) / 0.5))
What loss is used to train the first Chronos?
why: Correct: it is a classification over bins.
The first Chronos is not trained with MSE.

questions.q: How does Chronos-Bolt differ from the first Chronos?
options: It uses patches and predicts quantiles directly, so it is faster.
It only works for monthly data.

questions.q: Your series is ~100 everywhere, but one sensor glitch gives 100000. What happens with mean scaling?
options: The scale becomes huge; normal values land in a few bins and precision falls.
why: Correct: clean or clip outliers first.
It does not crash, but the forecast gets worse.

questions.q: You need to forecast demand using price and promotion as extra inputs with one foundation model from this family. Which is the best match?
options: Any model, covariates are never useful
